Name: Lilybrook - A Stardew Valley Expansion
Author: 8BitAlien
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/bb9zkDl.png[/img]
Take a short bus ride, and you'll arrive in Lilybrook. This expansion has new NPCs, fish, special orders, forageables, minerals, artifacts, and more! There are lots of locations to explore and secrets to discover.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/0uNrWu0.png[/img]
Lilybrook is home to 17 new NPCs with their own heart events, dialogue, and stories to discover. The dialogue and artwork of these NPCs have been carefully designed to match with the Vanilla game as closely as possible.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/gzRhGpR.png[/img]
Lilybrook is home to ﻿4 romanceable NPCs. Maybe you could find your soul mate?


[img]https://i.imgur.com/fRtGbFn.png[/img]
Lilybrook adds several new cooking recipes to the game! Befriend the village's NPCs and you might find these recipes in the mail. Gather the ingredients for these recipes through foraging or growing crops.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/6E0TuSm.png[/img]
There are lots of new crops and tree saplings to grow. There are even crops to grow during the Winter!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/YqDLBpQ.png[/img]
There are new locations to explore and discover in and around Lilybrook. Some of these areas will only be available through progression and unlocks.


﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/8DeoAwg.png[/img]
Furniture pieces are acquired in a few different ways. Collect them all, and decorate your house in style!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/57DlrQd.png[/img]
If you're looking for the feeling of adventure and discovery, whilst still wanting content to be true to the vanilla game, then Lilybrook is the place to be! All elements, from character sprites and portraits to dialogue, have been thoughtfully created to stay true to the base game's style while adding fresh new content. I plan to add updates to Lilybrook in the future adding even more new content. I already have lots of ideas!



Compatible with World Maps Everywhere and Livestock Bazaar along with many other mods. Any incompatibility issues you discover, feel free to let me know.
I am the sole developer of Lilybrook, so please bare with me if there are bugs or questions that need answering!
*** Lilybrook can be added to a new save or an existing one ***


**** I ONLY UPLOAD MY MODS TO NEXUSMODS SO DO NOT DOWNLOAD FROM ANYWHERE ELSE! ****
